<a id="summary"></a>

## Summary

PRD 008 (#346) shipped pods: `pij pod plan|up|show|confirm|set|down|add|release|sessions|activity|stage` and `pij sessions --history`. `docs/cli/pods.md` describes them as main ships them: a template named by its path, plan's warnings that each name a fix and never refuse, up and its tool canary, the degraded-slot brake, `E-RS-POD-EXISTS`, `E-RS-POD-MEMBER`, the secret refusal on `--set`, stages and write-back, the freeze at down, keep-open members and revival. Template procedures and shipped pod templates (PRD 010) are in a Coming section. The page is bundled as `pods` in `pages()`; concepts drops pods from its Coming section, defines the pod term as shipped and adds pod records and subject memory; the start page, building-a-role and the community route point at it.

<a id="goals"></a>

## Goals

- A seat reading `pij docs get pods` can plan, start, follow, change and take down a pod with what this pij ships.
- Nothing on the page or in concepts describes PRD 010 as shipped.

<a id="non-goals"></a>

## Non-goals

- A page generated from a pod-template catalog: PRD 008 compiles none in; templates are files a command names.
- Template procedures and shipped templates (PRD 010).
- Any change to pod behaviour or refusals.
